name: self-settings
description: Lets a session read this machine's plugin settings as the /config menu shows them (key, label, kind, choices, value, lock, set or at its default, and who may change it), and change only the options on a fixed list: each claude-code-self-tools plugin's update check, and self-compact's compact reminder, through Claude Code's own /config writer. Every other option is read only: the owner changes it in /config by hand. A sensitive field's value is never read, and a value that looks like a secret is never shown.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.
